name: Creamy Garlic Herb Wine Pork Chops
note: Adjudicator KEEP upheld. Adds the run's first pork (chop) dinner - widens protein spread. Cross-protein merge pass (my job as decider): the creamy-cream-sauce chassis appears in chicken via accepted creamy-tuscan-chicken-skillet, but this is a distinct dinner - protein differs (pork chop vs chicken breast) AND sauce accent differs (white-wine/lemon/thyme bistro pan sauce vs tuscan sun-dried-tomato/spinach). Two of four axes diverge, so not a twin. Note the creamy chicken-breast skillet glut (creamy-garlic-chicken-skillet, creamy-garlic-parmesan-mushroom-chicken-skillet) is being cut as dupes of the tuscan skillet this same pass, so the creamy-skillet family is NOT over-indexed by keeping one pork chop. Won its within-dispatch sibling contest over creamy-parmesan-garlic-pork-chops-skillet (rejected) on distinctness and macros (32g protein / 7g carbs). Almond flour / Italian seasoning / xanthan gum board-absent but flagged for the pricer lane per 5.1, not penalized. CROSS-PROTEIN WATCH: a white-wine cream-sauce chicken or turkey cutlet in another lane would twin this - reject against this acceptance.
